newsitem.title: USA: Shaman starts Virend Phase II trials.
newsitem.headline: Shaman starts Virend Phase II trials.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc on Tuesday said it has started Phase II trials of Virend, a topical agent for the recurrent genital herpes.

The study, which is double-blind, randomized and placebo-controlled, will examine Virend's ability to accelerate the healing of herpes lesions in AIDS patients when it is used with the drug, acyclovir.
The tests will treat 400 patients at 30 sites in the United States, Shaman said in a statement.
